name: RSS feed to daily digest
description: Watch an RSS feed, keep the newest entries, and render them into a single Markdown digest you can email or archive.
creator: Nodyra maintainers
prerequisites: Outbound HTTPS to the feed URL
expected_result: One Markdown digest per run listing the latest entries.
permissions: Network: the feed URL you configure

params.code:
items = input if isinstance(input, list) else (input or {}).get('items', [])
lines = [f"- [{i.get('title','untitled')}]({i.get('link','')})"
         for i in items]
output = {'markdown': '# Digest\n\n' + '\n'.join(lines),
          'count': len(lines)}
